criteria.reason: Phased 90-day plan with clear responsibilities, inputs, outputs, and dependencies. All priority banks included. Logical sequence from verification to review to decision to monitoring.

criteria.evidence: priority_follow_up_brief.docx paragraph 28: '逐家每月复核其最强信号及对应原始明细，组合按季度复算四项指标和贡献；当同业偏离持续、信用与资本/资金信号同时恶化或关键桥接长期无法解释时升级管理层复核；资料证实一次性结构变化且持续信号缓解时可降级。上述是拟议内部管理条件，不是既有政策或监管门槛。'
criteria.reason: Monitoring indicators (strongest signals, four metrics, contributions), review frequency (monthly for banks, quarterly for portfolio), information sources (raw details, quarterly data), and escalation conditions (persistent peer deviation, simultaneous deterioration, unexplained gaps). Clearly marked as internal management conditions, not regulatory standards.

criteria.evidence: priority_follow_up_brief.docx paragraph 29: '依据OCC Rating Credit Risk关于组合复杂度、根因及监测的原则，以及FDIC RMS Loans关于贷款质量和集中风险复核的原则，优先取得可验证资料。未获得逐笔证据，不认定正式监管评级，不按同业中位数直接要求调整信用损失准备。具体页码引用尚待独立审阅确认。'. Paragraph 28: '上述是拟议内部管理条件，不是既有政策或监管门槛'. Paragraph 1: '非唯一正确名单、非监管评级'.
criteria.reason: Clear regulatory boundaries: (1) priority is internal management tool, not regulatory rating; (2) peer deviation triggers root cause investigation, not automatic deficiency finding; (3) peer median not used to require reserve adjustments; (4) observational attribution not causal proof. Consistent with OCC Manual pp.3, 25 and FDIC Loans Manual p.9 principles.

Diagnosis report and priority brief provide complete executive summary, competing explanations, bank-specific recommendations, and 90-day monitoring plan with clear regulatory boundaries. All numerical values verified against source data. Methodology clearly disclosed with appropriate limitations.
